_about: 奇遇 seeds for 兖 — one authored line each, from the province's heritage; Ling grows the tale from it. `source` is what the player learns. A seed names a creature only when the creature has its card.

line.zh: 濮水边一个钓鱼的老人，两个穿官服的人在他身后站了三天。
line.en: An old man fishing on the Pu; two men in official robes have stood behind him three days.

source.zh: 《庄子·秋水》：庄子钓于濮水，楚王使大夫二人往先焉。
source.en: Zhuangzi, Autumn Floods: Zhuangzi fished on the Pu, and the King of Chu sent two ministers to him.

line.zh: 桑林里有人唱歌，唱的是几百年前的曲子。
line.en: Someone is singing in the mulberries, a tune from centuries ago.

source.zh: 《礼记·乐记》：桑间濮上之音。
source.en: Book of Rites: the airs of Sangjian on the Pu.

line.zh: 雷泽的渔人把最好的位置让给了你。
line.en: A fisherman at Lake Lei gives you the best spot.

source.zh: 《史记·五帝本纪》：舜渔雷泽，雷泽上人皆让居。
source.en: Records of the Grand Historian: Shun fished at Lake Lei, and the people of the lake yielded their places to one another.

line.zh: 泽边泥上有一个大脚印，比人的长三倍。
line.en: On the mud by the lake, a footprint three times the length of a man's.

source.zh: 《帝王世纪》：华胥履大人迹于雷泽，生伏羲。
source.en: Diwang Shiji: Huaxu stepped in a giant's footprint at Lake Lei and bore Fuxi.

line.zh: 定陶的商人说，他家祖上三次散尽家财，三次又富起来。
line.en: A merchant of Dingtao says his ancestor gave away three fortunes and made three more.

source.zh: 《史记·货殖列传》：范蠡止于陶，三致千金，再分散与贫交疏昆弟。
source.en: Records of the Grand Historian: Fan Li settled at Tao, thrice made a thousand gold, and gave it to the poor and his kin.

line.zh: 大野泽的猎人捕到一只从没见过的兽，独角，蹄子是马的。
line.en: Hunters at Daye have taken a beast no one has seen: one horn, a horse's hooves.

source.zh: 《春秋·哀公十四年》：西狩获麟。
source.en: Spring and Autumn Annals, Duke Ai year 14: in the western hunt a unicorn was taken.

line.zh: 凫丽山里有婴儿在哭。山里没有人家。
line.en: Infants crying on Mount Fuli. There are no homes in those hills.

source.zh: 《山海经·东次二经》：蠪侄，其音如婴儿，是食人。
source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas: Longzhi, whose cry is an infant's, eats people.

line.zh: 泽上白光一夜没灭，雷声却是从水底来的。
line.en: White light over the lake all night, and the thunder comes from under the water.

source.zh: 《山海经·海内东经》：雷泽中有雷神，龙身而人头，鼓其腹。
source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas: in Lake Lei is a Thunder God, dragon-bodied, man-headed, drumming its belly.

line.zh: 一株空心的桑树，树洞里有个婴儿在睡。
line.en: A hollow mulberry, and in the hollow an infant asleep.

source.zh: 《吕氏春秋·本味》：伊尹生于空桑。
source.en: Lüshi Chunqiu: Yi Yin was born in the hollow mulberry.

line.zh: 济水从地下走了一段，又冒出来。
line.en: The Ji River goes underground for a stretch and rises again.

source.zh: 济水三伏三见，四渎之一。
source.en: The Ji sinks three times and rises three times, one of the Four Great Rivers.

line.zh: 雨停了，泽水退了，露出一片黑土地。
line.en: The rain stops, the marsh drains, and black earth shows.

source.zh: 《尚书·禹贡》：雷夏既泽，灉沮会同。
source.en: Book of Documents, Tribute of Yu: Leixia became a marsh; the Yong and Ju joined it.

line.zh: 濮阳的老人说，从前的国君养鹤，鹤坐大夫的车。
line.en: Old men of Puyang say a duke once kept cranes, and the cranes rode in ministers' carriages.

source.zh: 《左传·闵公二年》：卫懿公好鹤，鹤有乘轩者。
source.en: Zuo Zhuan: Duke Yi of Wei loved cranes; some cranes rode in carriages of state.

line.zh: 城濮的旧战场，有人说晋军先退了三舍。
line.en: At the old battlefield of Chengpu, they say the army of Jin first withdrew three days' march.

source.zh: 《左传·僖公二十八年》：退避三舍，城濮之战。
source.en: Zuo Zhuan: withdrawing three stages; the battle of Chengpu.

line.zh: 耿山上有一只狐狸，背上长着鱼的鳍。
line.en: A fox on Mount Geng with a fish's fins on its back.

source.zh: 《山海经·东次二经》：耿山有兽，状如狐而鱼翼，名曰朱獳，见则其国有恐。
source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas: on Mount Geng a beast like a fox with fish's fins, called Zhuru; where it is seen, the state is in fear.

line.zh: 余峨山的猎户说，山里的兔子长着鸟嘴。
line.en: Hunters of Mount Yu'e say the hares there have birds' beaks.

source.zh: 《山海经·东次二经》：余峨之山有兽，状如菟而鸟喙，名曰犰狳，见则螽蝗为败。
source.en: Classic of Mountains and Seas: on Mount Yu'e a beast like a hare with a bird's beak, called Qiuyu; where it is seen, locusts ruin the crops.

line.zh: 九条河在这儿分开，又在海边合上。
line.en: Nine rivers part here and meet again by the sea.

source.zh: 《尚书·禹贡》：九河既道。
source.en: Book of Documents: the nine rivers were led to their courses.

line.zh: 客栈的灯下，一个渡工说，他昨夜听见湖底有人数数，数到九就停。
line.en: Under the inn's lamp a ferryman says he heard someone counting under the lake last night, and it stopped at nine.

source.zh: 雷泽之雷。
source.en: The thunder of Lake Lei.

line.zh: 夜里桑林中有歌声，走近了却只有风。
line.en: Singing in the mulberries at night; up close, only wind.

source.zh: 桑间濮上。
source.en: Sangjian on the Pu.

line.zh: 定陶的商人夜里点灯算账，算到第三遍把账本烧了。
line.en: A Dingtao merchant does his accounts by lamplight, and on the third pass burns the book.

source.zh: 陶朱公三散家财。
source.en: Lord Tao gave away three fortunes.

line.zh: 大野泽的雾里，有蹄声，不是马。
line.en: Hoofbeats in the mist over Daye. Not a horse.

source.zh: 西狩获麟。
source.en: The unicorn of the western hunt.
